title: Protests in Hyderabad against CEC Gyanesh Kumar over voter roll revision
seoTitle: Hyderabad protests against CEC Gyanesh Kumar

tea.why: Protesters alleged that CEC Gyanesh Kumar was undermining democracy by removing eligible voters from electoral rolls to benefit the BJP.
tea.want: Protesters demanded the immediate resignation and arrest of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar.
tea.changed: Oct 5: Telangana Congress Seva Dal held a one-day satyagraha in Hyderabad, with organizers announcing further demonstrations.

summary: The Telangana Pradesh Congress Seva Dal and INDIA bloc parties organized protests in Hyderabad on October 5, 2026. A one-day satyagraha was held at Gandhi Bhavan, led by Telangana Pradesh Congress Seva Dal president Middela Jitender, while another protest took place outside the Hyderabad Collectorate. Protesters alleged that Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar was undermining democratic values by removing eligible voters from electoral rolls to benefit the BJP. They demanded the immediate resignation and arrest of CEC Gyanesh Kumar. Organizers stated their commitment to peaceful means and announced plans for further agitation.
demands: Stop undermining constitutional institutions and democratic values
Stop removing eligible voters from electoral rolls
response: No official response reported in the sources.

updates.text: The Telangana Pradesh Congress Seva Dal organised a one-day satyagraha at Gandhi Bhavan in Hyderabad, demanding CEC Gyanesh Kumar's resignation.
Congress leader Motha Rohith stated that INDIA bloc parties protested outside the Hyderabad Collectorate, demanding the CEC's arrest and resignation.
A Congress leader announced further demonstrations against the Election Commission, including besieging Lok Bhawan on October 8 and a protest in Delhi on November 1.
